name: dividers
title: Dividers
description: Minimal Tailwind separators for a clean boundary between nearby pieces of content.
useWhen: Space alone is not enough to show a meaningful boundary between adjacent groups.
avoidWhen: A divider would add decoration without clarifying a relationship.
responsiveBehavior: Rules stretch only to their parent container and vertical rules keep a fixed height.
accessibility: Rule uses the native horizontal-rule element.
VerticalRule is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

variants.title: Rule
variants.description: A minimal horizontal boundary for adjacent content groups that need a visible separation.

variants.title: Vertical rule
variants.description: A quiet upright separator for compact inline groups such as metadata or command areas.
accessibility: Keep decorative separators hidden from assistive technology.
